<style>
:root{--bg:#05030b;--panel:rgba(10,7,24,.86);--panel2:rgba(17,10,35,.94);--cyan:#00f5ff;--pink:#ff2bd6;--purple:#9b5cff;--green:#4dff9b;--orange:#ffb84d;--white:#fff;--muted:#b9b3cc;--line:rgba(0,245,255,.24);--radius:20px;--content:1440px}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;color:var(--white);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);overflow-x:hidden}body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-3;background:linear-gradient(rgba(3,1,12,.40),rgba(3,1,12,.88)),url("https://i.pinimg.com/originals/f2/41/1d/f2411d91b7b6c6e310fcfa94b1af00e3.jpg") center/cover fixed}body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 10% 15%,rgba(0,245,255,.18),transparent 27%),radial-gradient(circle at 90% 20%,rgba(255,43,214,.18),transparent 28%),radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%,rgba(155,92,255,.18),transparent 35%),linear-gradient(rgba(0,245,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,43,214,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:auto,auto,auto,38px 38px,38px 38px}
a{color:var(--cyan)}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{color:inherit}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:12px clamp(14px,3vw,38px);background:rgba(5,3,13,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.4);box-shadow:0 8px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}.logo{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,29px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:4px;white-space:nowrap;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 7px var(--cyan),0 0 18px var(--cyan),0 0 30px var(--pink)}.logo::after{content:" ✦";font-size:.55em;color:var(--pink)}.search-wrap{position:relative;flex:1;max-width:680px}.search-wrap::before{content:"⌕";position:absolute;left:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-53%);font-size:25px;color:var(--cyan);pointer-events:none}.search{width:100%;padding:12px 16px 12px 42px;color:#fff;background:rgba(0,0,0,.44);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.35);border-radius:14px;outline:none;transition:.2s}.search::placeholder{color:#aaa3c1}.search:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,245,255,.09),0 0 20px rgba(0,245,255,.15)}.owner-mini{margin-left:auto;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;text-align:right;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.5}.owner-mini strong{color:#fff}.owner-mini a{color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}
.nav{max-width:var(--content);margin:auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px clamp(14px,3vw,38px)}.nav a{text-decoration:none}.nav button,.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;color:#f8f5ff;background:rgba(10,7,24,.82);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.32);border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:750;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s}.nav button:hover,.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--pink);background:rgba(34,12,45,.95);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,43,214,.18),0 0 12px rgba(0,245,255,.12)}
.hero{max-width:var(--content);margin:8px auto 22px;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,38px)}.hero-inner{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(24px,4vw,48px);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.34);border-radius:26px;background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(5,8,24,.92),rgba(35,8,44,.75)),rgba(8,5,20,.85);box-shadow:0 0 35px rgba(0,245,255,.08),inset 0 0 35px rgba(255,43,214,.05)}.hero-inner::after{content:"ANIFLEX";position:absolute;right:-8px;bottom:-30px;font-size:clamp(70px,15vw,190px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.08em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.035);pointer-events:none}.hero-kicker{color:var(--cyan);font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase}.hero h1{max-width:780px;margin:12px 0;font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,58px);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.035em}.hero h1 span{color:var(--cyan);text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(0,245,255,.3)}.hero p{max-width:650px;color:#c9c3d9;line-height:1.65;margin:0 0 20px}.hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(0,245,255,.17),rgba(255,43,214,.18))!important;border-color:rgba(0,245,255,.65)!important}.section-label{max-width:var(--content);margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,38px);color:#c8c2d9;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2.4px;text-transform:uppercase}
.catalog-head{max-width:var(--content);margin:20px auto 0;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,38px);display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.catalog-title{margin:0;font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,34px);letter-spacing:-.03em;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,245,255,.16)}.catalog-title span{color:var(--cyan)}.catalog-subtitle{margin:7px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.catalog-tools{max-width:var(--content);margin:16px auto 0;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,38px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px}.filter-select{min-width:155px;padding:10px 12px;color:#f8f5ff;background:rgba(7,5,18,.9);border:1px solid rgba(155,92,255,.38);border-radius:12px;outline:none}.filter-select:focus{border-color:var(--cyan)}.result-count{margin-left:auto;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(175px,1fr));gap:clamp(12px,1.5vw,20px);padding:18px clamp(14px,3vw,38px) 32px;max-width:var(--content);margin:auto}.card{position:relative;isolation:isolate;min-width:0;aspect-ratio:3/4.25;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;border-radius:18px;background-color:#100a20;background-size:cover;background-position:center;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.5);box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 0 15px rgba(0,245,255,.08);transition:transform .24s,border-color .24s,box-shadow .24s}.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.02) 35%,rgba(2,1,8,.18) 52%,rgba(2,1,8,.96) 100%)}.card::after{content:"↗";position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(5,3,13,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px);transition:.2s}.card:nth-child(3n){border-color:rgba(255,43,214,.6)}.card:nth-child(3n + 2){border-color:rgba(155,92,255,.7)}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.4),0 0 22px rgba(0,245,255,.22),0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}.card:hover::after{opacity:1;transform:none}.title{position:absolute;left:9px;right:9px;bottom:9px;z-index:2;padding:10px 11px;background:rgba(4,2,12,.82);border-radius:11px;border-left:3px solid var(--cyan);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-size:13px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:800}.card-meta{display:block;margin-top:5px;font-size:10px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#c3bed4}.card-status{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;z-index:2;padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.5);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(3,2,12,.82);color:var(--cyan);font-size:10px;font-weight:900;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}.card-status.soon{color:var(--orange);border-color:rgba(255,184,77,.6)}.empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:45px 20px;color:var(--muted);border:1px dashed rgba(0,245,255,.25);border-radius:18px;background:rgba(8,5,20,.65)}
.page{display:none;max-width:1100px;margin:20px auto;padding:18px clamp(14px,3vw,28px)}.page h2{text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--pink),0 0 22px var(--cyan)}.panel{padding:clamp(16px,3vw,28px);background:rgba(7,5,17,.9);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.25);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(0,0,0,.35);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}.ep{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:9px 0;padding:14px 16px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(9,7,20,.94),rgba(23,8,34,.9));border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.27);border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}.ep::before{content:"▶";display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(0,245,255,.09);color:var(--cyan);font-size:11px}.ep:hover:not(.lock){transform:translateX(4px);border-color:var(--pink);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,43,214,.15)}.lock{opacity:.72;cursor:not-allowed}.lock::before{content:"◷";color:var(--orange);background:rgba(255,184,77,.08)}
.info-section{max-width:var(--content);margin:28px auto;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,38px)}.info-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:15px;font-size:clamp(20px,2.5vw,26px);font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.02em}.info-title::after{content:"";height:1px;flex:1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,245,255,.45),transparent)}.info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,270px),1fr));gap:14px}.info-card{padding:18px;background:rgba(7,5,17,.88);border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.23);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,245,255,.045);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s}.info-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(255,43,214,.65)}.info-anime{font-weight:900;color:white}.info-episode{color:var(--cyan);font-size:13px;margin-top:6px}.info-date{color:var(--orange);font-size:12px;margin-top:6px}.info-status{display:inline-block;margin-top:9px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--green);border:1px solid var(--green);background:rgba(77,255,155,.08)}.news-date{color:var(--purple);font-size:11px}.news-title{margin-top:5px;font-weight:900}.news-text{margin-top:6px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.donor{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}.donor-place{width:30px;color:var(--orange);font-weight:900}.donor-name{flex:1;font-weight:800}.donor-amount{color:var(--green);font-weight:900;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(77,255,155,.4)}
.team-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:13px;margin-top:18px}.member{position:relative;padding:16px;background:rgba(13,9,28,.94);border:1px solid rgba(155,92,255,.42);border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden}.member::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:4px;background:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--purple)}.member.work::before{background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--green)}.member.vacation::before{background:var(--orange);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--orange)}.member-name{font-size:16px;font-weight:900}.member-real{margin-top:4px;color:#c3bdd0;font-size:13px}.badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:10px}.badge{padding:5px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}.level1{color:#c6ccd8;border:1px solid #707889;background:rgba(112,120,137,.12)}.level2{color:#61dfff;border:1px solid #00a9cf;background:rgba(0,245,255,.08)}.level3{color:#d8a9ff;border:1px solid #9b5cff;background:rgba(155,92,255,.1)}.level4{color:#ff9de8;border:1px solid #ff2bd6;background:rgba(255,43,214,.1)}
#player{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}#video,#iframePlayer{width:min(100%,1000px);max-height:82vh;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#000;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.35);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(0,245,255,.15)}#player .close-player{position:absolute;top:18px;right:20px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,43,214,.6);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(20,5,25,.9);cursor:pointer}
footer{max-width:var(--content);margin:38px auto 0;padding:25px clamp(14px,3vw,38px) 35px;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.2);color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;text-align:center;line-height:1.7}footer strong{color:#fff;letter-spacing:2px}
@media(max-width:760px){header{gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.logo{font-size:22px}.search-wrap{order:3;flex-basis:100%;max-width:none}.owner-mini{font-size:10px}.nav{padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:10px}.nav button{padding:9px 11px;font-size:12px}.hero{margin-top:4px}.hero-inner{border-radius:20px}.catalog-head{align-items:start;flex-direction:column}.catalog-tools{align-items:stretch}.filter-select{flex:1;min-width:135px}.result-count{width:100%;margin-left:0}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}.card{border-radius:14px}.title{font-size:12px;padding:8px}.card-status{top:7px;left:7px;font-size:9px}.info-section{margin:22px auto}.info-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.page{padding-top:12px}}
@media(min-width:761px) and (max-width:1050px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

/* Фирменный ярлычок ANIME и GIF-иллюстрации */
.brand-lockup{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-shrink:0}.anime-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:5px 9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,43,214,.65);border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(0,245,255,.12),rgba(255,43,214,.14));color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:1.2px;box-shadow:0 0 13px rgba(255,43,214,.16),inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,245,255,.06);white-space:nowrap}.anime-badge::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--cyan)}
.support-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:22px}.support-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;min-width:0;padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.26);border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(10,7,24,.9),rgba(27,8,39,.86));box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(0,245,255,.06);transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s}.support-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(255,43,214,.7)}.support-icon{font-size:28px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,43,214,.45))}.support-card h3{margin:8px 0}.support-card p{line-height:1.55}.section-gif{display:block;width:min(100%,300px);height:auto;aspect-ratio:5/3;object-fit:contain;margin:8px auto 14px;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.22);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.22);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(0,245,255,.1))}.section-gif-caption{color:#d8d2e6;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 auto 16px;max-width:520px}.tg-label{margin-top:12px;color:#aaa4c0;font-size:12px}.application-panel{max-width:780px;margin:auto}.application-panel h2{margin-top:22px}.application-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
@media(max-width:760px){.brand-lockup{gap:7px}.anime-badge{font-size:9px;padding:4px 7px;letter-spacing:.7px}.support-options{grid-template-columns:1fr}.support-card{padding:15px}.section-gif{max-width:260px}}


/* Уникальные неоновые рамки команды: уровни 1–7 */
.member{isolation:isolate;transition:transform .22s,border-color .22s,box-shadow .22s;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(13,9,28,.97),rgba(8,5,20,.94))}
.member:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.member .member-name{position:relative;z-index:1}
.member::after{position:absolute;right:10px;top:7px;font-size:23px;line-height:1;opacity:.82;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.member.rank-1{border:1px solid rgba(190,200,220,.8);box-shadow:inset 0 0 14px rgba(190,200,220,.06),0 0 9px rgba(190,200,220,.08)}
.member.rank-1::after{content:"✧";color:#d6deef;text-shadow:0 0 9px #d6deef;animation:rank-twinkle 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-2{border:1px solid #00c9ee;box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px rgba(0,201,238,.08),0 0 12px rgba(0,201,238,.16)}
.member.rank-2::after{content:"❄";color:#71eaff;text-shadow:0 0 10px #00dfff;animation:rank-float 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-3{border:1px solid #a66bff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 17px rgba(166,107,255,.1),0 0 13px rgba(166,107,255,.18)}
.member.rank-3::after{content:"✦";color:#d8b6ff;text-shadow:0 0 8px #a66bff,0 0 16px #a66bff;animation:rank-twinkle 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-4{border:1px solid #ff42d7;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,66,215,.09),0 0 14px rgba(255,66,215,.2)}
.member.rank-4::after{content:"⚡";color:#ff8de9;text-shadow:0 0 10px #ff2bd6;animation:rank-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-5{border:1px solid #ff9acb;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,154,203,.1),0 0 14px rgba(255,105,180,.2)}
.member.rank-5::after{content:"🌸";font-size:20px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #ff6bb5);animation:rank-sakura 4s linear infinite}
.member.rank-6{border:1px solid #ffc45c;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(255,196,92,.1),0 0 16px rgba(255,184,77,.22)}
.member.rank-6::after{content:"☄";color:#ffe0a0;text-shadow:0 0 10px #ffb84d;animation:rank-float 2s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-7{border:1px solid #fff2a0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(255,242,160,.12),0 0 13px rgba(255,220,90,.24);animation:rank-star-frame 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-7::after{content:"🌟";font-size:22px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ffe56b);animation:rank-twinkle 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-1::before,.member.rank-2::before,.member.rank-3::before,.member.rank-4::before,.member.rank-5::before,.member.rank-6::before,.member.rank-7::before{width:3px}
@keyframes rank-twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.45;transform:scale(.86) rotate(-8deg)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.12) rotate(8deg)}}
@keyframes rank-float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
@keyframes rank-pulse{0%,100%{filter:brightness(.85);transform:scale(.94)}50%{filter:brightness(1.5);transform:scale(1.12)}}
@keyframes rank-sakura{0%{transform:rotate(0) translateY(0)}50%{transform:rotate(12deg) translateY(3px)}100%{transform:rotate(0) translateY(0)}}
@keyframes rank-star-frame{0%,100%{box-shadow:inset 0 0 16px rgba(255,242,160,.08),0 0 10px rgba(255,220,90,.16)}50%{box-shadow:inset 0 0 22px rgba(255,242,160,.16),0 0 22px rgba(255,220,90,.38)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.member.rank-1::after,.member.rank-2::after,.member.rank-3::after,.member.rank-4::after,.member.rank-5::after,.member.rank-6::after,.member.rank-7::after,.member.rank-7{animation:none!important}}


/* ANIFLEX visual polish: status effects, one-time sakura welcome, ambient details */
.brand-lockup{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-shrink:0}
.anime-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,43,214,.65);border-radius:999px;color:#ffe9fb;background:linear-gradient(110deg,rgba(0,245,255,.1),rgba(255,43,214,.13));font-size:10px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.12em;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,43,214,.16);white-space:nowrap}
.member{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.member.vacation::before{content:"☂️";position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:8px;font-size:24px;opacity:.88;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #00dfff);animation:umbrella-bob 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.work::before{content:"⚙️";position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:8px;font-size:20px;opacity:.72;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #4dff9b);animation:work-spin 8s linear infinite}
.member.vacation{border-color:rgba(0,201,238,.48);box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,201,238,.05),0 0 12px rgba(0,201,238,.08)}
.member.work{border-color:rgba(77,255,155,.38)}
.member .badges .badge{position:relative}
.card-status:not(.soon)::before{content:"✦ ";animation:rank-twinkle 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;display:inline-block}
.card-status.soon::before{content:"✿ ";animation:rank-twinkle 2s ease-in-out infinite;display:inline-block}
.card-status.soon{background:rgba(45,22,8,.9);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,184,77,.13)}
.ep.lock{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ep.lock::after{content:"🌸 скоро";margin-left:auto;color:#ffc4e9;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap}
.ep:not(.lock)::after{content:"▶";margin-left:auto;color:var(--green);font-size:12px;text-shadow:0 0 9px var(--green)}
.visual-toast{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:300;max-width:min(360px,calc(100vw - 36px));padding:14px 17px;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.45);border-radius:16px;background:rgba(7,5,20,.94);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(0,245,255,.15);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);animation:toast-in .35s ease-out}
.visual-toast strong{display:block;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:4px}
.sakura-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:250;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.sakura-petal{position:absolute;top:-12vh;left:var(--left);font-size:var(--size);opacity:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(255,105,180,.5));animation:sakura-fall var(--duration) var(--delay) linear forwards;transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0deg)}
@keyframes sakura-fall{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,-4vh,0) rotate(0deg)}10%{opacity:.92}85%{opacity:.8}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(var(--drift),115vh,0) rotate(620deg)}}
@keyframes umbrella-bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-5deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(6deg)}}
@keyframes work-spin{0%,85%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}90%{transform:rotate(45deg)}95%{transform:rotate(-25deg)}}
@keyframes toast-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media(max-width:760px){header{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}.brand-lockup{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}.owner-mini{display:none}.search-wrap{max-width:none;flex-basis:100%}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(145px,1fr))}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sakura-petal,.member.vacation::before,.member.work::before,.card-status.soon::before{animation:none!important}.sakura-overlay{display:none}}


/* ANIFLEX sticker animation pack + reinforced rank frames (especially levels 5–7) */
.member.rank-5,.member.rank-6,.member.rank-7{position:relative;border-width:2px!important;isolation:isolate}
.member.rank-5{border-color:#ff9acb!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 22px rgba(255,105,180,.14),0 0 8px rgba(255,105,180,.32),0 0 22px rgba(255,105,180,.18)!important}
.member.rank-6{border-color:#ffc45c!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 24px rgba(255,196,92,.15),0 0 9px rgba(255,184,77,.35),0 0 24px rgba(255,184,77,.2)!important}
.member.rank-7{border-color:#fff2a0!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 26px rgba(255,242,160,.18),0 0 10px rgba(255,220,90,.48),0 0 28px rgba(255,220,90,.32)!important;animation:rank-star-frame 2.2s ease-in-out infinite!important}
.member.rank-5::after{content:'🌸';font-size:22px;color:#ff9acb;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #ff6bb5);animation:rank-sakura 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-6::after{content:'☄';font-size:23px;color:#ffe0a0;text-shadow:0 0 8px #ffb84d,0 0 17px #ffb84d;animation:rank-comet 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-7::after{content:'🌟';font-size:24px;color:#fff2a0;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #ffe56b) drop-shadow(0 0 13px #ffb84d);animation:rank-legendary 1.35s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.rank-5::before,.member.rank-6::before,.member.rank-7::before{width:4px!important}
@keyframes rank-comet{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(-8deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #ffb84d)}50%{transform:translate(-3px,-4px) rotate(12deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #ffb84d)}}
@keyframes rank-legendary{0%,100%{transform:scale(.88) rotate(-8deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px #ffe56b)}50%{transform:scale(1.2) rotate(9deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #fff2a0) drop-shadow(0 0 20px #ffb84d)}}
/* Decorative stickers and emoji get a subtle motion, without affecting buttons or text layout. */
.anime-badge::before{animation:sticker-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.support-icon{display:inline-block;animation:sticker-float 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:center}
.info-title>span,.member .badge,.card-status{transition:filter .2s,transform .2s}
.member .badge:hover,.card-status:hover{filter:brightness(1.3);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.member.vacation::before{animation:umbrella-bob 2.5s ease-in-out infinite,sticker-glow 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.member.work::before{animation:work-spin 6s linear infinite,sticker-glow 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.ep.lock::after{display:inline-block;animation:sticker-float 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sticker-float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(3deg)}}
@keyframes sticker-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.65;transform:scale(.9)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.25)}}
@keyframes sticker-glow{0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px currentColor)}50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px currentColor)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.member.rank-5,.member.rank-6,.member.rank-7,.member.rank-5::after,.member.rank-6::after,.member.rank-7::after,.anime-badge::before,.support-icon,.member.vacation::before,.member.work::before,.ep.lock::after{animation:none!important}}



/* ANIFLEX: анимированные разделы и навигация */
@keyframes navAura{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(0,245,255,0),inset 0 0 0 rgba(255,43,214,0);filter:saturate(1)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 17px rgba(0,245,255,.18),inset 0 0 12px rgba(255,43,214,.08);filter:saturate(1.22)}}
@keyframes stickerFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg)}35%{transform:translateY(-3px) rotate(-5deg)}70%{transform:translateY(1px) rotate(4deg)}}
@keyframes titleShimmer{0%,100%{text-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(0,245,255,.2),0 0 10px rgba(255,43,214,.08)}50%{text-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(0,245,255,.55),0 0 20px rgba(255,43,214,.32)}}
@keyframes sectionLine{0%{background-position:0 0;opacity:.55}50%{opacity:1}100%{background-position:220px 0;opacity:.55}}
.nav button,.nav a button{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;animation:navAura 4.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.nav button::before,.nav a button::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 15%,rgba(255,255,255,.11) 42%,transparent 68%);transform:translateX(-130%);transition:transform .55s ease}
.nav button:hover::before,.nav a button:hover::before{transform:translateX(130%)}
.nav button:active,.nav a button:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.nav button:nth-of-type(1){border-color:rgba(0,245,255,.52)}
.nav button:nth-of-type(2){border-color:rgba(155,92,255,.62);animation-delay:.25s}
.nav button:nth-of-type(3){border-color:rgba(255,43,214,.62);animation-delay:.5s}
.nav button:nth-of-type(4){border-color:rgba(255,184,77,.62);animation-delay:.75s}
.nav a:nth-of-type(1) button{border-color:rgba(0,170,255,.65);animation-delay:1s}
.nav a:nth-of-type(2) button{border-color:rgba(77,255,155,.5);animation-delay:1.25s}
.info-title{position:relative;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.17);border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(0,245,255,.055),rgba(255,43,214,.055),transparent 82%);animation:titleShimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite;overflow:hidden}
.info-title::first-letter{display:inline-block}
.info-title::after{height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--pink),var(--purple),transparent);background-size:220px 100%;animation:sectionLine 5s linear infinite}
.info-section:nth-of-type(1) .info-title{border-color:rgba(0,245,255,.28)}
.info-section:nth-of-type(2) .info-title{border-color:rgba(255,43,214,.28);animation-delay:.6s}
.info-section:nth-of-type(3) .info-title{border-color:rgba(255,184,77,.3);animation-delay:1.2s}
.info-section:nth-of-type(1) .info-title::before{content:"🎧";display:inline-block;animation:stickerFloat 3s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(0,245,255,.55))}
.info-section:nth-of-type(2) .info-title::before{content:"📰";display:inline-block;animation:stickerFloat 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(255,43,214,.55))}
.info-section:nth-of-type(3) .info-title::before{content:"🏆";display:inline-block;animation:stickerFloat 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(255,184,77,.55))}
.info-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.info-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--cyan),var(--pink),transparent);background-size:200% 100%;opacity:.55;animation:sectionLine 6s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}
.info-section:nth-of-type(2) .info-card::before{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--pink),var(--purple),transparent)}
.info-section:nth-of-type(3) .info-card::before{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--orange),#fff2a0,transparent)}
.info-card:hover{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,245,255,.12),0 0 18px rgba(255,43,214,.08)}
.info-status{animation:navAura 3.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.nav button,.nav a button,.info-title,.info-title::before,.info-title::after,.info-card::before,.info-status{animation:none!important}}

</style>

<style id="aniflex-max-visual">
/* ANIFLEX MAX VISUAL: extra motion, without replacing the original background */
:root{--afx-cyan:#00f5ff;--afx-pink:#ff35d3;--afx-purple:#9b5cff;--afx-gold:#ffd166}
@keyframes afxFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(3deg)}}
@keyframes afxGlow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 7px #00f5ff35, inset 0 0 5px #ff35d315}50%{box-shadow:0 0 20px #00f5ff75,0 0 34px #ff35d333,inset 0 0 12px #9b5cff22}}
@keyframes afxShine{0%{background-position:-220% 0}100%{background-position:220% 0}}
@keyframes afxTwinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.45;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px currentColor)}50%{opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px currentColor)}}
@keyframes afxBob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
@keyframes afxSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
button,a,.card,.anime-card,.info-card,.section-gif,.nav button,.nav a button{transition:transform .24s ease,filter .24s ease,box-shadow .24s ease}
button:hover,a:hover,.card:hover,.anime-card:hover,.info-card:hover{filter:brightness(1.12) saturate(1.12)}
button:hover,.nav a:hover button{transform:translateY(-2px);animation:afxGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
button:active,.nav a:active button{transform:scale(.96)}
.info-title,.aniflex-youtube-spotlight{animation:afxGlow 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.info-title:after,.aniflex-youtube-button{background-size:220% 100%;animation:afxShine 5s linear infinite,afxGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.info-title:before,.section-gif,.aniflex-youtube-icon{animation:afxBob 3s ease-in-out infinite,afxTwinkle 3.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.section-gif{border-radius:16px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #00f5ff55);max-width:100%;height:auto}
img{transition:filter .25s ease,transform .25s ease} .anime-card img,.card img{filter:saturate(1.08)} .anime-card:hover img,.card:hover img{transform:scale(1.035);filter:saturate(1.25) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #ff35d355)}
/* Tiny animated sparkle badge */
.anime-badge,.status-badge,.level-badge{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.anime-badge:after,.status-badge:after,.level-badge:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 20%,#ffffff38 48%,transparent 68%);background-size:220% 100%;animation:afxShine 4.5s linear infinite}
/* Ambient decorative stickers */
.afx-sticker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-inline:4px;animation:afxFloat 3.3s ease-in-out infinite,afxTwinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #ff35d355)}
.info-section:nth-of-type(1) .afx-sticker{color:#00f5ff}.info-section:nth-of-type(2) .afx-sticker{color:#ff35d3}.info-section:nth-of-type(3) .afx-sticker{color:#ffd166}
@media(hover:none){button:hover,.nav a:hover button{transform:none;animation:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
</style>


<style id="aniflex-anime-ui-upgrade">
:root{--anime-glow:0 0 14px rgba(0,245,255,.22),0 0 34px rgba(255,43,214,.10)}
body{background-attachment:fixed}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);background:rgba(5,3,15,.82)!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.25);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}
.logo{letter-spacing:.12em;text-shadow:0 0 8px #00f5ff,0 0 24px rgba(0,245,255,.6),0 0 40px rgba(255,43,214,.28);animation:logoAura 4s ease-in-out infinite}
.anime-badge{border-radius:999px!important;animation:badgeFloat 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;box-shadow:var(--anime-glow)}
.nav{position:sticky;top:74px;z-index:90;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);background:rgba(7,4,18,.76)!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(155,92,255,.2)}
.nav button,.hero-actions button,.btn{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease,border-color .22s ease!important}
.nav button::after,.hero-actions button::after,.btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-60% auto -60% -45%;width:35%;transform:rotate(20deg);background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.24),transparent);transition:left .65s ease;z-index:-1}
.nav button:hover::after,.hero-actions button:hover::after,.btn:hover::after{left:130%}
.nav button:hover,.hero-actions button:hover,.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.025);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,245,255,.22),0 0 26px rgba(255,43,214,.16)}
.hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.hero::before{content:"✦   ✧   ·   ✦   ·   ✧";position:absolute;right:4%;top:16%;font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,48px);letter-spacing:.4em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);text-shadow:0 0 18px var(--cyan);animation:starDrift 9s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none}
.hero-inner{animation:heroEnter .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.hero-kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid rgba(0,245,255,.25);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,245,255,.055);box-shadow:var(--anime-glow)}
.catalog-head{scroll-margin-top:150px}
.catalog-title,.info-section h2,.aniflex-youtube-spotlight h2{text-wrap:balance}
.grid .card{transform-origin:center bottom;animation:cardRise .55s both;transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow .28s,border-color .28s}
.grid .card:nth-child(3n+2){animation-delay:.05s}.grid .card:nth-child(3n){animation-delay:.1s}
.grid .card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.025);z-index:3;box-shadow:0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22),0 0 28px rgba(0,245,255,.22)}
.card-status{animation:statusPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.info-section,.aniflex-youtube-spotlight{position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.info-section:hover,.aniflex-youtube-spotlight:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(0,245,255,.12),0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.info-section h2::first-letter{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(0,245,255,.5))}
input:focus,select:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,245,255,.1),0 0 20px rgba(0,245,255,.12)!important}
button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan);outline-offset:3px}
@keyframes logoAura{0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(0,245,255,.2))}50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(0,245,255,.7)) drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(255,43,214,.25))}}
@keyframes badgeFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
@keyframes starDrift{0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(0);opacity:.45}50%{transform:translate3d(-12px,10px,0) rotate(7deg);opacity:.9}}
@keyframes heroEnter{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes cardRise{from{opacity:.2;translate:0 10px}to{opacity:1;translate:0 0}}
@keyframes statusPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(255,184,77,0)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,184,77,.16)}}
@media(max-width:680px){header{position:relative}.nav{top:0;display:flex;overflow-x:auto;flex-wrap:nowrap;scrollbar-width:thin;padding-bottom:10px}.nav>a,.nav>button{flex:0 0 auto}.hero{padding-top:36px;padding-bottom:36px}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:12px}.card{border-radius:15px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
</style>

<style id="aniflex-sakura-cinema">
:root{--sakura:#ff9ed8;--ice:#91f5ff;--gold:#ffe6a3;--glass:rgba(12,8,29,.72)}
body{background-color:#070513;background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -10%,rgba(111,54,180,.22),transparent 55%)}
body::before{filter:saturate(.82) hue-rotate(7deg);background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(6,3,19,.43) 0%,rgba(7,4,22,.67) 48%,rgba(4,3,13,.93) 100%),url("https://i.pinimg.com/originals/f2/41/1d/f2411d91b7b6c6e310fcfa94b1af00e3.jpg");transform:scale(1.025);animation:cinemaBg 32s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes cinemaBg{from{background-position:center center}to{background-position:52% 46%}}
body::after{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 18%,rgba(0,245,255,.14),transparent 32%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 87% 23%,rgba(255,43,214,.16),transparent 32%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 48% 82%,rgba(155,92,255,.13),transparent 40%),linear-gradient(rgba(0,245,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,43,214,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:auto,auto,auto,42px 42px,42px 42px;animation:gridDrift 24s linear infinite}
@keyframes gridDrift{to{background-position:0 42px,0 0,0 0,42px 42px,42px 42px}}
/* Sakura particles: decorative, lightweight and independent from page content */
.sakura-cinema{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;contain:strict}
.sakura-petal{position:absolute;top:-12vh;left:var(--x);font-size:var(--size);opacity:0;color:var(--sakura);text-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(255,158,216,.8);animation:petalFall var(--dur) linear var(--delay) infinite;will-change:transform,opacity}
@keyframes petalFall{0%{transform:translate3d(0,-5vh,0) rotate(0deg);opacity:0}8%{opacity:var(--alpha)}50%{transform:translate3d(var(--sway),52vh,0) rotate(300deg)}92%{opacity:var(--alpha)}100%{transform:translate3d(calc(var(--sway) * -1),112vh,0) rotate(650deg);opacity:0}}
header{background:rgba(7,4,20,.78);border-bottom-color:rgba(255,158,216,.38);box-shadow:0 8px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 1px 0 rgba(0,245,255,.12);transition:background .25s,border-color .25s}
.logo{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,var(--ice),#fff,var(--sakura));background-size:220% auto;background-clip:text;-webkit-background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:logoShimmer 6s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(0,245,255,.28))}
@keyframes logoShimmer{to{background-position:220% center}}
button,a,.card,.anime-card,.panel,.section-card{transition:transform .22s ease,border-color .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease,filter .22s ease}
button:hover,a:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)}
button:active{transform:scale(.97)}
:where(.card,.anime-card,.panel,.section-card,[class*="card"]){backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
:where(.card,.anime-card,[class*="anime-card"]):hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.26),0 0 18px rgba(0,245,255,.12)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ice)!important;outline-offset:3px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}.sakura-cinema{display:none}}
</style>

<style id="aniflex-mascot-styles">

#af-mascot-launcher{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:9998;width:72px;height:72px;border:2px solid #00f5ff;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%,#43206a,#090615 70%);box-shadow:0 0 14px #00f5ff,0 0 34px #a855f7;cursor:pointer;color:white;font-size:32px;animation:af-float 3s ease-in-out infinite;transition:transform .2s}
#af-mascot-launcher:hover{transform:scale(1.12) rotate(-5deg)}
#af-mascot-launcher:after{content:'AI';position:absolute;right:-2px;bottom:-1px;background:#ff2bd6;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:12px;font:bold 10px Arial;padding:3px 5px;box-shadow:0 0 10px #ff2bd6}
#af-chat{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:108px;width:min(365px,calc(100vw - 28px));height:min(510px,calc(100vh - 145px));z-index:9999;display:none;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #00f5ff;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(18,10,39,.98),rgba(4,7,20,.98));box-shadow:0 0 18px #00f5ff66,0 0 45px #a855f744;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);color:#fff;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
#af-chat.af-open{display:flex;animation:af-pop .22s ease-out}
#af-chat-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:13px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #00f5ff55;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#16102c,#0a1c2b)}
#af-avatar{width:42px;height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ff8ddd;box-shadow:0 0 14px #ff2bd688;font-size:24px;background:#211035;animation:af-float 3s ease-in-out infinite}
#af-headtext{flex:1} #af-headtext b{display:block;color:#9dfaff;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.5px} #af-headtext small{color:#bcb3d3;font-size:11px}
#af-close{border:0;background:transparent;color:#fff;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}
#af-messages{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;scroll-behavior:smooth}
.af-msg{max-width:91%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;animation:af-msg-in .2s ease-out}
.af-bot{align-self:flex-start;background:#17152b;border:1px solid #a855f755;border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
.af-user{align-self:flex-end;background:#07303b;border:1px solid #00f5ff77;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
#af-chips{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow:auto;padding:0 12px 9px} .af-chip{white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid #a855f7aa;border-radius:16px;background:#1a1230;color:#f4eaff;padding:6px 9px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}
#af-form{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:10px;border-top:1px solid #00f5ff44;background:#080817} #af-input{min-width:0;flex:1;border:1px solid #514275;border-radius:12px;padding:11px;background:#100d20;color:#fff;outline:none} #af-input:focus{border-color:#00f5ff;box-shadow:0 0 10px #00f5ff44} #af-send{border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:0 14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00d9ee,#8b5cf6);color:#090619;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer}
#af-toast{position:fixed;z-index:10000;left:50%;top:18px;transform:translate(-50%,-20px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;background:#150d28;border:1px solid #ff2bd6;color:#fff;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 0 22px #ff2bd677;font: bold 15px Arial;transition:.25s} #af-toast.af-show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@keyframes af-float{0%,100%{translate:0 0}50%{translate:0 -7px}} @keyframes af-pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}} @keyframes af-msg-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:480px){#af-mascot-launcher{right:14px;bottom:14px;width:62px;height:62px}#af-chat{right:10px;bottom:88px;width:calc(100vw - 20px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#af-mascot-launcher,#af-avatar,.af-msg{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

</style>
</head>

/* =====================================================
   ЭЛЕМЕНТЫ
===================================================== */

const home =
    document.getElementById("home");

const page =
    document.getElementById("page");

const player =
    document.getElementById("player");

const video =
    document.getElementById("video");

const iframe =
    document.getElementById("iframePlayer");

const searchInput =
    document.getElementById("searchInput");

const teamPage =
    document.getElementById("teamPage");

const supportPage =
    document.getElementById("supportPage");

const applicationPage =
    document.getElementById("applicationPage");

const siteInfoBlock =
    document.getElementById("siteInfo");


/* =====================================================
   ОТОБРАЖЕНИЕ РАСПИСАНИЯ
===================================================== */

function renderSchedule() {

    const container =
        document.getElementById("scheduleList");

    if (!container) return;

    container.innerHTML = "";

    siteInfo.schedule.forEach(item => {

        container.innerHTML += `

            <div class="info-card">

                <div class="info-anime">
                    ${escapeHTML(item.anime)}
                </div>

                <div class="info-episode">
                    🎙️ ${escapeHTML(item.episode)}
                </div>

                <div class="info-date">
                    📅 ${escapeHTML(item.date)}
                </div>

                <span class="info-status">
                    ${escapeHTML(item.status)}
                </span>

            </div>

        `;

    });
}


/* =====================================================
   ОТОБРАЖЕНИЕ НОВОСТЕЙ
===================================================== */

function renderNews() {

    const container =
        document.getElementById("newsList");

    if (!container) return;

    container.innerHTML = "";

    siteInfo.news.forEach(item => {

        container.innerHTML += `

            <div class="info-card">

                <div class="news-date">
                    ${escapeHTML(item.date)}
                </div>

                <div class="news-title">
                    ${escapeHTML(item.title)}
                </div>

                <div class="news-text">
                    ${escapeHTML(item.text)}
                </div>

            </div>

        `;

    });
}


/* =====================================================
   ОТОБРАЖЕНИЕ ДОНАТЕРОВ
===================================================== */

function renderDonors() {

    const container =
        document.getElementById("donorList");

    if (!container) return;

    container.innerHTML = "";

    siteInfo.donors.forEach((donor, index) => {

        container.innerHTML += `

            <div class="info-card">

                <div class="donor">

                    <div class="donor-place">
                        #${index + 1}
                    </div>

                    <div class="donor-name">
                        ${escapeHTML(donor.name)}
                    </div>

                    <div class="donor-amount">
                        ${escapeHTML(donor.amount)}
                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        `;

    });
}


/* =====================================================
   ОТОБРАЖЕНИЕ ВСЕЙ ИНФОРМАЦИИ
===================================================== */

function renderSiteInfo() {

    renderSchedule();

    renderNews();

    renderDonors();

}


/* =====================================================
   ДОПОЛНИТЕЛЬНЫЕ СТРАНИЦЫ
===================================================== */

function hideExtraPages() {

    teamPage.style.display = "none";

    supportPage.style.display = "none";

    applicationPage.style.display = "none";
}


function showTeam() {

    closePlayer();

    home.style.display = "none";
    page.style.display = "none";
    siteInfoBlock.style.display = "none";

    hideExtraPages();

    teamPage.style.display = "block";

    window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth"
    });
}


function showSupport() {

    closePlayer();

    home.style.display = "none";
    page.style.display = "none";
    siteInfoBlock.style.display = "none";

    hideExtraPages();

    supportPage.style.display = "block";

    window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth"
    });
}


function showApplication() {

    closePlayer();

    home.style.display = "none";
    page.style.display = "none";
    siteInfoBlock.style.display = "none";

    hideExtraPages();

    applicationPage.style.display = "block";

    window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth"
    });
}


/* =====================================================
   ЭКРАН ГЛАВНОЙ
===================================================== */

function render(list) {
    home.innerHTML = "";
    const count = document.getElementById("resultCount");
    if (count) count.textContent = `Найдено: ${list.length}`;

    if (list.length === 0) {
        home.innerHTML = `<div class="empty"><strong>Ничего не найдено 😔</strong><br><br>Попробуй изменить запрос или фильтр.</div>`;
        return;
    }

    list.forEach(item => {
        const index = data.indexOf(item);
        const card = document.createElement("article");
        card.className = "card";
        card.tabIndex = 0;
        card.setAttribute("role", "button");
        card.setAttribute("aria-label", `Открыть аниме ${item.title}`);
        card.style.backgroundImage = `url("${String(item.poster || "").replaceAll('"', '%22')}")`;
        const hasEpisodes = item.episodes.some(episode => Boolean(episode.v));
        const status = hasEpisodes ? "Доступно" : "Скоро";
        card.innerHTML = `
            <span class="card-status ${hasEpisodes ? "" : "soon"}">${status}</span>
            <div class="title">${escapeHTML(item.title)}<span class="card-meta">${item.episodes.length} сер. · ${hasEpisodes ? "есть видео" : "ожидается"}</span></div>
        `;
        card.addEventListener("click", () => openAnime(index));
        card.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
            if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                event.preventDefault();
                openAnime(index);
            }
        });
        home.appendChild(card);
    });
}

function applyCatalogFilters() {
    const query = (searchInput.value || "").trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru");
    const status = document.getElementById("statusFilter")?.value || "all";
    const sort = document.getElementById("sortFilter")?.value || "default";
    let filtered = data.filter(anime => {
        const matchesQuery = anime.title.toLocaleLowerCase("ru").includes(query);
        const hasEpisodes = anime.episodes.some(episode => Boolean(episode.v));
        const matchesStatus = status === "all" || (status === "available" && hasEpisodes) || (status === "soon" && !hasEpisodes);
        return matchesQuery && matchesStatus;
    });
    if (sort === "az") filtered.sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "ru"));
    if (sort === "za") filtered.sort((a, b) => b.title.localeCompare(a.title, "ru"));

    page.style.display = "none";
    hideExtraPages();
    siteInfoBlock.style.display = query || status !== "all" ? "none" : "block";
    home.style.display = "grid";
    render(filtered);
}

/* =====================================================
   ОТКРЫТЬ АНИМЕ
===================================================== */

function openAnime(index) {

    hideExtraPages();

    siteInfoBlock.style.display = "none";

    const anime =
        data[index];

    if (!anime) {
        return;
    }

    home.style.display = "none";

    page.style.display = "block";


    let html = `

        <button
            class="btn"
            onclick="showAll()">

            ⬅ Назад

        </button>

        <h2>
            ${escapeHTML(anime.title)}
        </h2>

    `;


    anime.episodes.forEach(
        (episode, episodeIndex) => {

            const available =
                Boolean(episode.v);

            html += `

                <div
                    class="ep ${available ? "" : "lock"}"

                    ${
                        available
                        ? `onclick="playEpisode(${index}, ${episodeIndex})"`
                        : ""
                    }
                >

                    ${escapeHTML(episode.t)}

                </div>

            `;
        }
    );


    page.innerHTML =
        html;


    window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth"
    });
}


/* =====================================================
   ЗАПУСК СЕРИИ
===================================================== */

function playEpisode(
    animeIndex,
    episodeIndex
) {

    const anime =
        data[animeIndex];

    if (!anime) {
        return;
    }


    const episode =
        anime.episodes[episodeIndex];

    if (!episode || !episode.v) {
        return;
    }


    const url =
        episode.v;


    player.style.display =
        "flex";


    video.pause();

    video.removeAttribute("src");

    iframe.removeAttribute("src");


    video.style.display =
        "none";

    iframe.style.display =
        "none";


    /* Cloudinary */

    if (
        url.includes(
            "player.cloudinary.com/embed"
        )
    ) {

        iframe.src =
            url;

        iframe.style.display =
            "block";

        return;
    }


    /* MP4 */

    video.src =
        url;

    video.style.display =
        "block";

    video.load();

    const playPromise =
        video.play();


    if (
        playPromise !== undefined
    ) {

        playPromise.catch(
            () => {}
        );
    }
}


/* =====================================================
   ЗАКРЫТЬ ПЛЕЕР
===================================================== */

function closePlayer() {

    player.style.display =
        "none";


    video.pause();

    video.removeAttribute(
        "src"
    );

    video.load();


    iframe.removeAttribute(
        "src"
    );


    video.style.display =
        "none";

    iframe.style.display =
        "none";
}


/* =====================================================
   ГЛАВНАЯ
===================================================== */

function showAll() {

    closePlayer();

    hideExtraPages();

    page.style.display =
        "none";

    home.style.display =
        "grid";

    siteInfoBlock.style.display =
        "block";

    render(data);

    renderSiteInfo();

    searchInput.value = "";
    const statusFilter = document.getElementById("statusFilter");
    const sortFilter = document.getElementById("sortFilter");
    if (statusFilter) statusFilter.value = "all";
    if (sortFilter) sortFilter.value = "default";

    window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: "smooth"
    });
}


/* =====================================================
   ПОИСК
===================================================== */

function search(text) {
    applyCatalogFilters();
}

/* =====================================================
   ЗАЩИТА HTML
===================================================== */

function escapeHTML(text) {

    return String(text)

        .replaceAll(
            "&",
            "&amp;"
        )

        .replaceAll(
            "<",
            "&lt;"
        )

        .replaceAll(
            ">",
            "&gt;"
        )

        .replaceAll(
            '"',
            "&quot;"
        )

        .replaceAll(
            "'",
            "&#039;"
        );
}


/* =====================================================
   ПОИСК
===================================================== */

searchInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    function () {

        search(
            this.value
        );

    }
);


/* =====================================================
   ESC
===================================================== */

document.addEventListener(
    "keydown",
    function(event) {

        if (
            event.key === "Escape"
        ) {

            closePlayer();

        }

    }
);


/* =====================================================
   ЗАПУСК
===================================================== */


// Назначаем участникам командные рамки по их уровню (1–7).
document.querySelectorAll('.member').forEach(function(member) {
    const levelBadge = member.querySelector('[class*="level"]');
    if (!levelBadge) return;
    const match = levelBadge.className.match(/\blevel([1-7])\b/);
    if (match) {
        member.classList.add('rank-' + match[1]);
        member.setAttribute('data-rank', 'Уровень ' + match[1]);
    }
});

render(data);

renderSiteInfo();

</script>


<script>
/* One-time welcome effect: sakura petals fall on the first visit in this browser. */
(function(){
  const key='aniflex-sakura-welcome-v1';
  const overlay=document.getElementById('sakuraOverlay');
  if(!overlay || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
  let seen=false;
  try{seen=sessionStorage.getItem(key)==='1';}catch(e){}
  if(seen) return;
  try{sessionStorage.setItem(key,'1');}catch(e){}
  const petals=['🌸','✿','❀','🌸','✾'];
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    const petal=document.createElement('span');
    petal.className='sakura-petal';
    petal.textContent=petals[Math.floor(Math.random()*petals.length)];
    petal.style.setProperty('--left',Math.random()*100+'%');
    petal.style.setProperty('--size',(13+Math.random()*17)+'px');
    petal.style.setProperty('--duration',(4.8+Math.random()*4.2)+'s');
    petal.style.setProperty('--delay',(Math.random()*2.4)+'s');
    petal.style.setProperty('--drift',(-100+Math.random()*200)+'px');
    overlay.appendChild(petal);
  }
  window.setTimeout(()=>overlay.remove(),11500);
})();
</script>


<style>
/* ANIFLEX YouTube spotlight */
.aniflex-youtube-spotlight{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;margin:30px auto;padding:clamp(18px,3vw,30px);max-width:1100px;border:1px solid rgba(255,45,125,.65);border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(20,12,38,.96),rgba(8,20,38,.96));box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(0,225,255,.13),inset 0 0 24px rgba(255,45,125,.08);color:#fff}
.aniflex-youtube-spotlight:before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:-50%;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent 0 65%,rgba(0,245,255,.13),rgba(255,45,160,.15),transparent 78%);animation:aniflexYTOrbit 12s linear infinite}
.aniflex-youtube-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}.aniflex-youtube-icon{flex:0 0 72px;width:72px;height:56px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff2d78,#ff1744);font-size:30px;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,30,90,.5);animation:aniflexYTBeat 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}.aniflex-youtube-copy{flex:1;min-width:220px}.aniflex-youtube-copy h2{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:clamp(19px,3vw,27px);text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,245,255,.4)}.aniflex-youtube-copy p{margin:0;color:#d7e6f8;line-height:1.55}.aniflex-youtube-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:13px;text-decoration:none!important;color:#fff!important;font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#ff1744,#ff3986);box-shadow:0 0 17px rgba(255,23,68,.35);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;animation:aniflexYTGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite}.aniflex-youtube-button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.025);box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(255,23,68,.65)}.aniflex-youtube-note{font-size:12px;color:#9eb2cc;margin-top:12px}
@keyframes aniflexYTOrbit{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes aniflexYTBeat{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.07)}}@keyframes aniflexYTGlow{0%,100%{filter:brightness(1)}50%{filter:brightness(1.18)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.aniflex-youtube-spotlight:before,.aniflex-youtube-icon,.aniflex-youtube-button{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
<section class="aniflex-youtube-spotlight" aria-label="Видео ANIFLEX на YouTube">
 <div class="aniflex-youtube-inner">

 </div>
 <div class="aniflex-youtube-note">Открывается YouTube с результатами поиска ANIFLEX, отсортированными по дате загрузки.</div>
</section>


<!-- ANIFLEX Sakura AI mascot merged from the companion file -->
<button id="af-mascot-launcher" aria-label="Открыть ИИ-помощника ANIFLEX" title="Спросить маскота ANIFLEX">🌸</button>
<section id="af-chat" role="dialog" aria-label="ИИ-помощник ANIFLEX" aria-modal="false">
 <div id="af-chat-head"><div id="af-avatar">🐱</div><div id="af-headtext"><b>САКУРА · ANIFLEX AI</b><small>Помощник сайта · отвечает по данным страницы</small></div><button id="af-close" aria-label="Закрыть">×</button></div>
 <div id="af-messages" aria-live="polite"></div>
 <div id="af-chips"><button class="af-chip" data-q="Какая озвучка сейчас в работе?">🎙️ Озвучка</button><button class="af-chip" data-q="Кто топ донатеров?">🏆 Донатеры</button><button class="af-chip" data-q="Какие есть аниме?">🍥 Каталог</button><button class="af-chip" data-q="Кто владелец сайта?">👑 О сайте</button></div>
 <form id="af-form"><input id="af-input" autocomplete="off" maxlength="240" placeholder="Спроси что-нибудь…" aria-label="Вопрос помощнику"><button id="af-send" type="submit">➤</button></form>
</section><div id="af-toast" role="status"></div>

<script id="aniflex-mascot-script">
(()=>{
 const launch=document.getElementById('af-mascot-launcher'), panel=document.getElementById('af-chat'), close=document.getElementById('af-close'), messages=document.getElementById('af-messages'), form=document.getElementById('af-form'), input=document.getElementById('af-input'), toast=document.getElementById('af-toast');
 if(!launch||!panel||!messages||!form||!input)return;
 let badCount=0, toastTimer=null;
 const norm=x=>String(x??'').toLocaleLowerCase('ru').replace(/ё/g,'е').trim();
 function say(text,who='bot'){const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='af-msg '+(who==='user'?'af-user':'af-bot');el.textContent=text;messages.appendChild(el);messages.scrollTop=messages.scrollHeight;}
 function open(){panel.classList.add('af-open');if(!messages.dataset.welcomed){say('Привет! Я Сакура 🌸 — маскот ANIFLEX. Могу подсказать, что есть в каталоге, какие озвучки в работе и кто указан в топе донатеров. Спрашивай!');messages.dataset.welcomed='1';}setTimeout(()=>input.focus(),80)}
 function notify(text){toast.textContent=text;toast.classList.add('af-show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('af-show'),3000)}
 function getArr(key){try{return Array.isArray(window[key])?window[key]:[]}catch(e){return []}}
 function getAnime(){try{return typeof data!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(data)?data:getArr('data')}catch(e){return getArr('data')}}
 function getInfo(){try{return typeof siteInfo!=='undefined'?siteInfo:(window.siteInfo||{})}catch(e){return window.siteInfo||{}}}
 function answer(q){const n=norm(q), info=getInfo(), anime=getAnime();
  if(/^(67|six.?seven|сик.?севен)$/.test(n)||n.includes('67 мем')){notify('SIX SEVEN! ✨');return '67! SIX SEVEN! 😹';}
  if(/^(привет|здравствуй|хай|ку)\b/.test(n))return 'Привет-привет! 🌸 Что хочешь узнать про ANIFLEX?';
  if(/владелец|создател|кто хозяин|администратор/.test(n))return 'В информации сайта не всегда указан владелец. Проверь раздел «О сайте» или ссылки на официальные соцсети, чтобы не получить неверный ответ.';
  if(/ютуб|youtube|канал/.test(n))return 'Ссылку на YouTube лучше открыть через кнопку соцсетей на сайте. Я не буду угадывать адрес канала, если его нет в данных страницы.';
  if(/донат|топ донат/.test(n)){const list=Array.isArray(info.donors)?info.donors:[];if(!list.length)return 'В данных страницы пока не нашёл список донатеров. Загляни в раздел «Топ донатеров».';return '🏆 Топ донатеров по данным сайта:\n'+list.slice(0,5).map((x,i)=>`${i+1}. ${x.name||'Без имени'} — ${x.amount||'сумма не указана'}`).join('\n');}
  if(/озвуч|расписан|в работе|работает сейчас|вышла озвучка/.test(n)){const list=Array.isArray(info.schedule)?info.schedule:[];if(!list.length)return 'Расписание пока не найдено в данных страницы. Открой раздел «Расписание озвучки».';let filtered=list.filter(x=>!(/какая озвучка|расписан|в работе|вышла озвучка/.test(n))&&norm(x.anime).split(/\s+/).some(w=>w.length>3&&n.includes(w)));if(!filtered.length)filtered=list;return '🎙️ Расписание озвучки с сайта:\n'+filtered.slice(0,8).map(x=>`• ${x.anime||'Аниме'} — ${x.episode||'серия не указана'}\n  ${x.status||'Статус не указан'}${x.date?' · '+x.date:''}`).join('\n');}
  if(/аниме|каталог|серия|серий|800 лет|жена/.test(n)){if(!anime.length)return 'Не удалось прочитать каталог из данных страницы. Открой каталог ANIFLEX.';let found=anime.filter(x=>{const title=norm(x.title);return (title&&n.split(/[^a-zа-я0-9]+/i).filter(w=>w.length>2).some(w=>title.includes(w)))||(/какие есть аниме|покажи аниме|каталог/.test(n)&&title)});if(!found.length&&/800 лет|жена/.test(n))return 'Не нашёл этот тайтл в текущем каталоге. Если добавишь его в список аниме на сайте, я смогу находить его по тем же данным. 🌸';if(!found.length)found=anime.slice(0,8);return '🍥 По каталогу ANIFLEX:\n'+found.slice(0,8).map(x=>{const eps=Array.isArray(x.e)?x.e.length:(Array.isArray(x.episodes)?x.episodes.length:null);return '• '+(x.title||'Без названия')+(eps!==null?' — '+eps+' сер.':'')}).join('\n');}
  if(/заявк|команд|вступ|присоедин/.test(n))return '🎙️ Хочешь в команду? Нажми «Подать заявку» на сайте — там находится форма и актуальные условия.';
  if(/поддерж|донат/.test(n))return '💜 Поддержать проект можно через кнопку «Поддержать» на сайте. Спасибо, что помогаешь ANIFLEX!';
  if(/спасибо/.test(n))return 'Всегда пожалуйста! 🌸 Хорошего просмотра!';
  return 'Хмм, я пока не нашла ответ в данных сайта. Попробуй спросить про каталог аниме, расписание озвучки, топ донатеров или заявку в команду. 🌸';
 }
 function submit(text){const value=String(text||'').trim();if(!value)return;say(value,'user');input.value='';const n=norm(value);const profanity=/(сука|бля|бляд|хуй|пизд|еба|нахуй|мудак)/i.test(n);const gibberish=value.length>12&&!/[аеёиоуыэюяa-z]/i.test(value);if(profanity||gibberish){badCount++;if(badCount===1){say('Эй! 😾 Давай без грубостей и загадочных заклинаний. Спроси нормально — я же стараюсь помочь!');return;}if(badCount===2){say('Последнее предупреждение, нyaa! 😼 Напиши понятный вопрос, а то включу режим испуганного котика.');return;}badCount=0;notify('БУ! 👻 Неожиданность от Сакуры!');say('А-А-А! 👻 Ладно, это был маленький сюрприз! Давай теперь дружно и по делу 🌸');return;}say(answer(value));}
 launch.addEventListener('click',()=>panel.classList.contains('af-open')?panel.classList.remove('af-open'):open());close.addEventListener('click',()=>panel.classList.remove('af-open'));form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();submit(input.value)});document.querySelectorAll('.af-chip').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>submit(b.dataset.q||'')));
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
